title: National Goals 2026
description: Defines per-country national goals that drive AI decision-making, territorial ambitions, and economic strategies. Each country has 1-3 goals with priority tiers.

mode.description: Scenario goals files only (the scenario's nationalGoalsFile). "replace" (default) swaps the base game's goal table for this file: countries it does not list have no agenda. "merge" keeps the base table and appends this file's goals, per country and in the shared _BASIC set; a goal id may not repeat a base goal's id.

target_countries.description: ISO3 codes of countries this goal targets

agenda_panel_id.description: Optional panel route hint for agenda tasks, e.g. quickrecruit:air, quickbuild, diplomacy

agenda_subject.description: Optional explicit subject text shown in generated agenda task copy

ai_weight.description: How strongly the AI pursues this goal (0=ignore, 1=all-in)

incompatible_with.description: Goal IDs that are mutually exclusive with this goal

prerequisites.description: Goal IDs of the same country (or _BASIC) that must be completed before this goal can be chosen or completed (all of them). Unknown, self, other-country and cycle-closing entries are dropped at load. Empty or absent = no prerequisites.

mutually_exclusive.description: Goal IDs of the same country (or _BASIC) whose completion makes this goal unavailable. The relation is made symmetric at load. (incompatible_with above is informational only and has no effect.)

editor_position.description: [column, row] of the goal in the Mod Builder's goal graph. The game ignores it.

on_complete_flag.description: Optional event flag set on the country when the goal completes (player and AI). Other goals' has_flag tasks, mod events' has_flag conditions and prerequisites.flag / requires_flag gates can test it.

on_complete_event.description: Optional event id queued for the player's country when the goal completes (queued like a script's fire_event: its conditions and cooldowns are not checked). AI countries do not fire it.

on_complete_effects.description: Stat effects applied when the goal is achieved

tasks.description: Custom ECS-condition tasks. When present, overrides the type-based auto-generated tasks.

goal.description: Text fields accept either the literal or the '<field>_key' localization key; supply one of title or title_key.

id.description: Unique task identifier within the goal

panel_id.description: Optional panel route hint for UI navigation

required_count.description: How many times the condition must be met, or the absolute total it compares against for counting conditions such as military_units_above (default 1). No upper bound: CountryAgendaService reads it into a plain int, the 1450 scenario asks for 50,000 men, and a bounded integer would render as an unusable slider in the Mod Builder.

task.description: Text fields accept either the literal or the '<field>_key' localization key; supply one of title or title_key.

params.description: Condition-specific parameters (target_iso3, partners, province_owner, min_value, objective_id, flag_name, etc.). has_flag / not_has_flag take flag_name: the event flag (set by a set_flag effect or another goal's on_complete_flag) that must be / must not be set on the country; the AI also treats them as a completion predicate. alliance_with needs target_iso3 (one country) or partners (comma-separated ISO3 list, or "*" for any country); it counts distinct countries holding a bilateral alliance or Defense Pact with the owner. military_units_above: min_value is the requirement when required_count is absent. sphere_member counts the members of the owner's sphere of influence: target_iso3 or partners (comma-separated ISO3 list, or absent for any member) and/or region (a WorldRegion name such as SoutheastAsia; a member must match both when both are given); required_count is the target.
